methods.name: General GMM two-step linear IV with HAC weights on sandwich's lag convention (Bartlett, Parzen, Truncated, Tukey-Hanning), with and without VAR(1) prewhitening
methods.reference: gmm::gmm 1.9.1 (vcov = 'HAC', bw = L + 1) on sandwich 3.1.3 weightsAndrews; gmm::specTest
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n <= 1000: coefficients 1e-8, SEs and statistics 1e-6

deviations.quantity: Quadratic Spectral coefficients, SEs, J and lag count (qs_*, qs_pw_*)
deviations.note: p2a keeps the L-lag rule k(j/L), j = 1..=L, for the Quadratic Spectral kernel; sandwich sums every lag up to n - 1. No review finding covers the QS lag rule: ECON-68 is cited only as the closest finding (it names gmm's default QS kernel and bandwidth)
